record.question: Which of the following approach can be followed to reduce dispensing errors?
options: Separating drugs with similar names and appearances.
Always writing the correct diagnosis clearly
Minimizing the use of single use vials.
Placing route of administration posters in the pharmacy.
record.explanation: Answer A: Separating drugs with similar names and appearances.. Separating look-alike/sound-alike medicines is a recognized strategy to reduce selection and dispensing errors. Reference: https://www.ismp.org/recommendations/tall-man-letters. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
